Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiConnectionEndpointInfo

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiConnectionEndpointInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DexpiConnectionEndpointInfo extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable source-evidence summary for one endpoint referenced by Proteus-compatible DEXPI material connections.

Incoming and outgoing occurrences retain connection-evidence IDs in source order. This record does not classify branches or reconstruct live ProcessSystem topology.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

      public DexpiConnectionEndpointInfo(String endpointId, String elementName, String ownerId, String ownerElementName, boolean resolved, List<String> incomingConnectionIds, List<String> outgoingConnectionIds)
      Creates immutable endpoint-incidence evidence.
      Parameters:
      endpointId - explicit source endpoint identity
      elementName - resolved endpoint XML element name, or empty when unresolved
      ownerId - explicit endpoint owner identity, or empty when absent
      ownerElementName - endpoint owner XML element name, or empty when absent
      resolved - whether the endpoint resolves in the source document
      incomingConnectionIds - incoming connection-evidence IDs in source order
      outgoingConnectionIds - outgoing connection-evidence IDs in source order
